name: first-contact-demo
app_ids: com.qp1ng.android.demo (QR exchange, a second debug install beside the real app)
devices: Phone B: Samsung Galaxy A30 (SM-A305GT), Android 11
capture: Screen recordings of two real phones. The QR exchange was recorded with a second install of the app with fresh identities; the messages with the regular install and its existing contacts.
demonstrated_actions: Scan it with the other phone
Delivery and notification on the other phone
limits: QR exchange and messages recorded in separate takes, with different app installs and contact names
Typing and navigation accelerated; sending and delivery shown in real time
The address book is always protected from screen capture, so its few seconds are cut
editing: Scenes alternate between the two phones; status and navigation bars removed. The labels name the phone. Delivery times are from the recordings: about 2 s for the message, about 4 s for the reply.

scenes.label: 01 / PHONE A / SHOW MY CONTACT QR
scenes.en: Phone A shows its contact as an animated QR. Phone B scans it and saves the verified identity.
scenes.it: Il telefono A mostra il proprio contatto come QR animato. Il telefono B lo scansiona e salva l’identità verificata.

scenes.label: 02 / PHONE B / SHOW MY CONTACT QR
scenes.en: Then the other way round: now each phone has the other in its address book.
scenes.it: Poi al contrario: ora ognuno ha l’altro in rubrica.

scenes.label: 03 / PHONE A / Q-CHAT
scenes.en: Phone A opens the chat and writes. The contact has a verified identity and a direct P2P link.
scenes.it: Il telefono A apre la chat e scrive. Il contatto ha l’identità verificata e un collegamento P2P diretto.

scenes.label: 03 / PHONE A / OPEN THE CHAT / ACCELERATED
04 / PHONE A / SEND / REAL TIME
scenes.en: Send: the message leaves phone A for phone B.
scenes.it: Invio: il messaggio parte dal telefono A verso il telefono B.

scenes.label: 04 / PHONE B / SAME MOMENT / REAL TIME
scenes.en: Phone B, same moment: the message arrives about 2 seconds after sending. The notification does not show the text.
scenes.it: Il telefono B, nello stesso momento: il messaggio arriva circa 2 secondi dopo l’invio. La notifica non mostra il testo.

scenes.label: 05 / PHONE B / 1 UNREAD MESSAGE
scenes.en: Phone B opens the chat, reads and replies.
scenes.it: Il telefono B apre la chat, legge e risponde.

scenes.label: 06 / PHONE A / REPLY RECEIVED / REAL TIME
scenes.en: Phone A gets the reply about 4 seconds after it was sent.
scenes.it: Il telefono A riceve la risposta circa 4 secondi dopo l’invio.
